name: MedPsy-4B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507: 36 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.411 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-28. CARD-TABLE COMPLETION 2026-11-01: HealthBench and HealthBench-Hard each carry seven per-capability rows on the card and none were recorded, only the two Overall scores. Added all fourteen. They matter because the model's headline claim is token efficiency, and the capability breakdown shows where the 3.2x-shorter answers actually come from: on plain HealthBench Context Seeking is the biggest gain over MedGemma-27B (+13.00, 71.67 v 58.67) while Response Depth is only +2.34 (63.67 v 61.33) - it finds the right context and writes less about it. On HealthBench Hard the same ordering holds but wider (Context Seeking +21.33, Response Depth +9.00). Same CompassJudger-2-32B-Instruct judge as the recorded Overall rows.
